The ratio of net debt (including pensions) to EBITDA ... was 2.3x (31 December 2025: 2.0x) ... 54% of them were at fixed rates ... committed bank facilities aggregating $4.1bn ... these facilities were undrawn

controles.affirmation: "8 733 M£ contre 7 443 M£ un an plus tot, soit +1 532 M£ sur le semestre ecoule"
controles.verbatim_source: Net debt at 30 June 2026 was £8,733m, an increase of £1,532m since 31 December 2025 ... (31 December 2025: £7,201m)
controles.correction_proposee: Les deux chiffres sont exacts mais le "soit" est arithmetiquement incoherent : 8 733 - 7 443 = 1 290 M£ sur un an. Le +1 532 M£ se calcule contre 7 201 M£ au 31 decembre 2025. Reformuler en separant les deux bases.
